goal: Create a typed client from environment variables and fetch the 20 most recent published posts with their author's name through a foreign-key relation, handling the error case.
Insert a new row and return it, then upsert a batch of rows on a unique email column, and delete rows older than 30 days.
Sign up a user with email and password and a display name stored in user metadata, sign in, read the current session, and sign out.
Start a GitHub OAuth sign-in that redirects back to /auth/callback, and separately send a one-time magic link to an email address.
Listen for auth state changes and log sign-ins and sign-outs, and stop listening when asked.
Upload a file to a storage bucket with a content type and upsert enabled, create a signed URL valid for one hour, and get the public URL for another file.
Subscribe to inserts and updates on a messages table filtered by room id, and to presence in that room, and clean up the subscription.
Call a Postgres function with arguments and get a typed result, and invoke an edge function with a JSON body and an extra header.
